main.description: An immutable record of one completed atkuzu (Binairo/Takuzu) daily puzzle, written to the player's own PDS. Write-once: no field may change after creation. The record key is the puzzle number as a string (e.g. `412`), so each puzzle can be recorded at most once per account and re-solving cannot overwrite or spam.

puzzleNumber.description: Daily puzzle index = whole UTC days since the shared epoch, +1. Launch day = 1.

puzzleDate.description: UTC midnight datetime of the puzzle's calendar day.

solved.description: Whether the player finished the puzzle (grid fully and correctly filled).

durationSeconds.description: Time taken to finish the puzzle, in seconds.

toggleCount.description: Total number of cell toggles made during the attempt (including corrections). Optional efficiency stat, absent if not tracked.

createdAt.description: When the player finished the puzzle and the record was created.
